## Description
Briefly explain the changes made in this pull request and the motivation behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance improvement / refactoring
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Security / privacy hardening

## Pre-Submission Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run release:check` passes
- [ ] No scraped datasets included
- [ ] No copyrighted media included
- [ ] No credentials/session data included
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic/sanitized
- [ ] Documentation updated when required
- [ ] AI-assisted contributions (if any) have been thoroughly reviewed and validated
